data.action: 端坐在复古木椅前，优雅执白瓷茶壶为对面斟茶，眉眼含笑温和
data.description: 【薇薇安娜 · 罗德岛茶室的温茶叙话】罗德岛阳光温和的欧式贵宾茶室内，白瓷茶具散发着大吉岭红茶的清香。薇薇安娜端坐在古典木椅前，双手稳稳提起精致的瓷质茶壶，将金红色的红茶注入眼前的茶杯中，金鹿巨角在室内绿植掩映下显得格外温柔——「博士，请用茶。在忙碌的事务之余，偶尔也让身心沉浸在茶香与宁静中吧。」
data.lighting: 柔和窗光与室内暖白壁灯漫射
data.location: 罗德岛欧式贵宾会客茶室
data.promptProse: Viviana sits in the carved wooden guest-room chair, carefully lifting a porcelain teapot with both hands and pouring red-gold Darjeeling into the cup before her. Her camel coat and cream turtleneck remain visible in the eye-level medium shot. The cup and saucer occupy the nearer tabletop; the teapot spout points directly over the cup, and greenery overlaps the wall behind her antlers. A second, farther chair partly disappears behind the table, showing the tea room continuing beyond the portrait. Soft window light creates a pale stripe on the curved teapot and a small reflection on the tea. Warm wall light fills the shaded wrists without erasing the contact shadows below the saucer.
data.title: 薇薇安娜 · 罗德岛茶室的温茶叙话
